proof_body:
by
  intro G _
  have h : (MulAut.conj : G →* MulAut G).ker = Subgroup.center G := by
    ext g
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, Subgroup.mem_center_iff, MulEquiv.ext_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h x
      have := h x
      simp only [MulAut.conj_apply, MulAut.one_apply] at this
      calc x * g = g * x * g⁻¹ * g := by rw [this]
        _ = g * x := by group
    · intro h x
      simp only [MulAut.conj_apply, MulAut.one_apply]
      rw [← h x]; group
  exact ⟨(QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq h.symm).trans (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange MulAut.conj)⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G], Nonempty ((G ⧸ Subgroup.center G) ≃* (MulAut.conj : G →* MulAut G).range)
